summary: Co-founded [ResearchWiseAI](https://researchwiseai.com/), a product that automates market-research survey-data analysis using generative AI. I owned the technical architecture and product direction from concept through customer delivery.
Advise clients on technical strategy, team building and product development. I also deliver training on AI adoption and domain-driven design for engineering teams.
Led IT, product delivery, architecture, security and compliance for a UK startup connecting mothers. Built and ran the engineering function end-to-end as its sole technical leader at C-level.

Led the Platform: Foundation tribe, formerly Membership & Enterprise, providing leadership and architectural oversight across identity and access management, multi-tenancy, membership management, consent, feature control, profile management and data-subject tooling.

The tribe also supported the Core Business Services squad, which held deep knowledge of some of Babylon's longest-running systems. At its peak, Platform: Foundation included more than 70 people, including 55 engineers.

Led the Consumer & Business squad and, with its product manager, redefined it as Core Business Services to clarify its remit. Grew the team from 5 to 25 people, then reorganised its wide-ranging responsibilities into several spin-off squads.

Core Business Services, the new squads and an existing team then formed Membership & Enterprise, one of Babylon's first platform tribes, which I went on to lead.

Developed backend systems in Ruby as part of Babylon's Core Team, focusing on complex, cross-cutting concerns. Delivered federated authentication with partners, replaced an integer identifier system that was not designed for global scale, and prepared legacy systems for GDPR.

Led engineering for CLOSER Discovery, a search engine publishing documentation from some of the UK's largest and longest-running longitudinal studies. Owned engineering decisions, technical consultancy and coordination between participating organisations.

Chaired the Technical Oversight Committee and served as lead engineer for the search engine and its metadata tooling.

Managed a team of Metadata Assistants enhancing longitudinal-study documentation retrospectively. Established documentation standards and procedures to maintain consistent, high-quality metadata across the participating studies.

Led technical architecture for a game-based market-research platform. Worked with clients, external development teams and hosting providers to deliver bespoke data-collection games. All projects collected personal information, so I ensured compliance with the Data Protection Act and appropriate informed-consent processes.
Built a bespoke data-collection tool for rapidly designing and curating game-based surveys. Led development of its database and supporting tools using PHP and MySQL.
